q1_issues.issue: (Measure (sk_lower_heart $x) risk 88 percent) states an absolute risk-magnitude of the lowering event, not the 88-percent reduction the text asserts, and the same mis-slot repeats for stroke at 80 percent.
"the scientists claim" is a definite plural with a distributive predicate, so alongside the group event the per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x sk_scientist_1) is required and is missing.

q2_gaps: a measured change on an event -- "lower/reduce X by N percent" (Measure states an absolute value, MoreBy compares two entities, and percentages otherwise only appear as (Fraction p 100) in partitives)
a quantified Implication rule sealed as an attitude complement: sealing is specified for propositions, and a rule's strength/quantifier force has no carrier inside a seal
the remote/hypothetical conditional "if X V-ed, Y would V" -- the instruction set names only the indicative Implication and the past-perfect subjunctive Counterfactual
notes: Sealing the conditional under claim's Theme, projecting the definite "the pill", withholding tense from the subjunctive antecedent and consequent, and the heart_attack genus are all handled correctly.
